notes.title: Version 2.0.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I uploaded the new version 2.0.0.5 of LUISOAC, here are the changes:

[list]
[*] Added support for an easier way of reporting bugs, you can find more information in the discussion here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1742930/discussions/0/4695658043402124761/

[/list]
As regards the requested languages: I hope I can add them soon, thank you for your patience!

As always, thanks for your messages and your continuous support! 🍀

notes.title: Version 2.0.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I uploaded the new version 2.0.0.4 of LUISOAC, here are the changes:

[list]
[*] Fixes;
[*] Localization fixes.
[/list]
I updated the "Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling (Original Soundtrack)" files with a better format that should allow you to listen to them also from the Steam Music Player without issues.
The DLC's OSTs are coming soon: working on setting up the Steam page and other music platforms pages.

I am also looking into the new bugs shared in the discussions: thanks for the patience and for playing! 🍀

notes.title: Explore your ceiling on your mobile phone, the mobile version is available today
notes.notes:
Hello, players! Thank you for your support for our game! 💛

"Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling" will be launched today on the Apple Store and Google Play. 🥳
Selling price $1.99.

App Store
https://apps.apple.com/au/app/luisoac/id6451037627

Google Play
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.silver978.luisoac


The registration for the Scholastic Aptitude Test will end in a few days. How are you doing if you are about to face the exam? Are you uncomfortable due to exam pressure?

Pressure is everywhere in life, and our game also starts from a girl who wants to explore the ceiling under pressure.

This is a short psychological adventure. We hope it can bring you some relaxation and fun when you are under pressure. We are not alone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101998/aefb3c689f4a97b6590968e852cb6b73b44b9f36.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date and price announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are glad to announce that Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling is going to be released in full release at 6 a.m. on 9 March (EST) for 1.99$ with a 10% discount. 
Many thanks for your waiting. 
Please add us to your wishlist for the latest release news and tell your friends about us if you like Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling!

Full release features:
A short but meaningful story. How will the girl experience the psychological adventure?
All three endings. "To be or not to be." Or just...
Exploration mode. Let's lore about the girl's behind!

We look forward to seeing you on the release day!
